description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing shopping cart state in a React/Redux e-commerce application. It includes actions for adding/removing items, calculating totals, handling cart persistence via localStorage, and initiating checkout and cart creation via API calls.

methods.name: handleAddToCart
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart, validates quantity, updates localStorage, and dispatches relevant actions.

methods.name: handleRemoveFromCart
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart based on its ID, updates localStorage, and dispatches actions.

methods.name: calculateCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price of items in the cart and updates the state and localStorage.

methods.name: handleCart
methods.description: Initializes cart state from localStorage and dispatches it to Redux store.

methods.name: handleCheckout
methods.description: Initiates checkout process by redirecting to login and showing a notification.

methods.name: handleShopping
methods.description: Redirects user to shopping page and toggles cart visibility.

methods.name: getCartId
methods.description: Creates a new cart ID via API if none exists, based on current cart items.

methods.name: setCartId
methods.description: Stores cart ID in localStorage and updates Redux store.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears cart data from localStorage and Redux store.
